text: This is Zana. Your projects, agents, and tools, in one place.
Start with a project. Pick a folder, and your agents have a place to work.
Choose your agent, then tell it what you want to build.
Send it off. Zana keeps the conversation and the work together.
The Agents board shows what's working, and what needs your attention.
When the agent asks a question, answer it here. Then it carries on.
Check the changes and test results as they come in.
When it's ready, review the result and open the preview.
Prefer the terminal? Choose CLI Agent to open the agent's native interface.
Watch commands, file changes, and test output stream into the terminal.
Threads and CLI Agents share the same board, so you can keep track of both.
Your GUS tickets are here too. Filter by Me and the current sprint.
Open a ticket, review the details, and watch the work you want to follow.
Work with agent brings the ticket context into a draft. Review it, then send.
Need a tool of your own? Create a plugin.
Just describe it. A Focus Board with priorities, checkboxes, and a completion count.
The agent builds your idea and checks that it works.
Review the access it needs, then install it locally.
And there it is. Your own panel, right in the sidebar.
Check things off, add a task, and make it part of your day.
Start a project. Give an agent a goal. Stay in the loop, and make Zana your own.
